northwind-employee-handbook.pdf: Northwind Logistics Employee Handbook (synthetic sample document). Section 1: Working hours. The standard working week at Northwind Logistics is 37.5 hours. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time, Monday to Friday. Employees may start between 07:00 and 10:00 as long as core hours are covered.

Section 2: Time off. Full-time employees receive 26 days of paid vacation per calendar year. Part-time employees receive vacation pro rata to their contracted hours. Up to 5 unused vacation days may be carried over into the next year; carried-over days expire on 31 March. Vacation requests must be submitted at least 10 working days in advance through the PeopleHub portal.

Section 3: Remote work. Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week after completing their probation period of 6 months. Remote work from another country requires written approval from the People team and is limited to 20 working days per year. Northwind provides a one-time home office allowance of 400 euros.

Section 4: Expenses and security. Expense claims must be filed within 30 days of the purchase and require an itemised receipt. Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to 45 euros per day. Laptops must use full-disk encryption, and lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT service desk within 24 hours.
aurora-battery-manual.pdf: Aurora Power battery manual (synthetic sample document). Chapter 1: Models. The Aurora X2 is a 5,000 mAh portable battery with one USB-C port. The Aurora X3 is a 10,000 mAh portable battery with two USB-C ports and wireless charging.

Chapter 2: Charging. The Aurora X2 supports 30 watt fast charging and reaches a full charge in about 2 hours. The Aurora X3 supports 65 watt fast charging and reaches a full charge in about 1.5 hours. Never charge either battery at temperatures above 45 degrees Celsius.

Chapter 3: Warranty. The Aurora X2 carries a 12 month limited warranty. The Aurora X3 carries a 24 month limited warranty. Warranty claims require the serial number printed under the rubber cover and proof of purchase. Water damage is not covered for either model.
greenfield-refund-policy.txt:
Greenfield Outfitters Refund Policy, version 1 (synthetic sample document).

Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after the returned item is inspected. Sale items marked final sale cannot be returned. Return shipping is free for members of the Greenfield Club; other customers pay a flat 6 dollar return fee.
